text: A marsh hunter concealed among spirit reeds. Fast strikes carry a short poison.
Reed Stalkers hide in Overworld swamps and mangrove swamps, in the March Reed Fen and in the Crystal Fields.
It has **22 health** and **1 armour**, moves fast and hits for **4**. Each bite poisons you for 3 seconds. Bring milk, or keep your distance and let it come to you.
pages.title: Where and how

text: A Reed Fang attunes into 2 Attuned Echoes under Spirit.
pages.title: What it gives

text: No charm will bond a Reed Stalker.
